tagline.zh: 越接近目标,奔向目标的行动力越强。给清晰的进度指示、在起点预置「人为进度」,把资源投在收尾冲刺段——离目标越近,每一步的动机越足。
tagline.en: Effort toward a goal intensifies as the goal gets closer. Give clear progress indicators, pre-seed 'artificial progress' at the start, and invest in the final stretch — the nearer the goal, the stronger each step's pull.

origin.zh: Clark Hull 1932 年提出假说,1934 年大鼠奔食实验证实「越接近食物跑得越快」;人类证据来自 Kivetz/Urminsky/Zheng 关于购买加速与虚幻进度(artificial progress)的研究(out/design-study/12-expansion.md §14;lawsofux goal-gradient-effect 页)。
origin.en: Clark Hull proposed the hypothesis in 1932 and his 1934 food-race rat experiments confirmed it — rats speed up as food nears; the human evidence comes from Kivetz, Urminsky & Zheng on purchase acceleration and artificial progress (out/design-study/12-expansion.md §14; the lawsofux goal-gradient-effect page).

effect.zh: JS 型参数:集章卡总章数(demo 教学参数,定律本身不规定数值)。默认 10 章是一张典型集章卡的规模;改小会让「收尾冲刺」来得更快,改大则中途动力低谷更明显。
effect.en: JS-type param: total stamps on the punch card (demo teaching param; the law itself sets no number). The default 10 matches a typical reward card; shrinking it brings the final sprint sooner, growing it makes the mid-journey motivation dip more visible.

effect.zh: JS 型参数:起点预盖的「人为进度」(artificial progress)章数。默认 1 取「步骤条/会员卡预盖一枚已完成章」的签名巧思(12 补研 §16-9);调 0 即无预盖对照——对比开局第一下的间隔,就能看到虚幻进度对开局的拉动。
effect.en: JS-type param: 'artificial progress' stamps pre-punched at the start. The default 1 comes from the signature trick 'pre-stamp one completed slot on steppers/reward cards' (supplement research 12 §16-9); set 0 for the no-head-start control — comparing the very first interval shows the pull of illusory progress on the opening step.

note.zh: 演示全部使用原生 DOM/CSS/JS(div 集章格、button、transition),无新特性依赖,现代浏览器均可运行。
note.en: The demo uses only native DOM/CSS/JS (div stamp slots, buttons, transitions) — no cutting-edge features; any modern browser runs it.

fallback.zh: 定律的工程出口:进度必须「清晰 + 真实 + 可见收尾」。可降级路径:无 CSS 特性依赖;若业务拿不到真实进度数据,可按 Kivetz 等的「人为进度」思路预置已完成步骤(必须如实验明,不得虚报剩余量);没有进度指示的界面,至少给出「还差几步」的文本。注意 NN/g 分层:>1s 才用指示器,≥10s 必须用 percent-done(调研 07§20)。
fallback.en: The engineering exit: progress must be 'clear + honest + with a visible finish'. Degradation path: no CSS feature to fall back on; when real progress data is unavailable, pre-seed completed steps per Kivetz et al.'s artificial progress (always disclosed, never misstate what remains); on surfaces with no progress indicator at all, at least state 'N steps left' as text. Mind NN/g's layering: indicators only past 1s, percent-done mandatory past 10s (research 07 §20).

use.zh: 会员卡/集章/积分体系:起点预盖一枚章(人为进度),收尾阶段集中投放激励
use.en: Loyalty cards, stamp collecting, points systems: pre-stamp one slot (artificial progress) and concentrate rewards on the final stretch

use.zh: 多步流程(注册/结账/引导):清晰的步骤条 + 百分比,让「还差两步」可见
use.en: Multi-step flows (sign-up/checkout/onboarding): a clear stepper + percentage makes 'two steps left' visible

use.zh: 加载等待:≥10s 的操作给 percent-done 进度条(NN/g,调研 07§20),进度线本身就是目标梯度的载体
use.en: Waiting: percent-done progress bars for ≥10s operations (NN/g, research 07 §20) — the progress line is itself a goal-gradient carrier

avoid.zh: 虚报进度:预盖章必须如实标注为「人为进度」,把剩余量谎报为已完成是欺骗(虚幻进度研究的伦理边界)
avoid.en: Misreporting progress: pre-stamped slots must be disclosed as artificial progress; passing remaining work off as done is deception (the ethical edge of illusory-progress research)

avoid.zh: 把进度藏在最后一屏才揭晓——梯度需要「越来越近」的持续感知
avoid.en: Hiding progress until a final reveal — the gradient needs a continuously felt 'getting closer'

avoid.zh: 目标过大且无中间里程碑(如 0→100% 只有一根空进度条):没有近目标,就没有加速
avoid.en: One huge goal with no milestones (e.g. an empty 0→100% bar): no near goal, no acceleration

a11y.zh: 进度信息必须双通道:集章格之外,「已集 n/N · 百分比 · 还差 m 章」与每次打卡间隔都以文本呈现并经 aria-live 播报;集章格不靠颜色单独区分(已集格带 ✓ 字符);间隔柱状图有逐柱数值文本;prefers-reduced-motion 下集章动画与进度条过渡全部取消,数值即时更新。
a11y.en: Progress must be dual-channel: beyond the stamp slots, 'n/N collected · percent · m stamps left' and every punch interval appear as text and are announced via aria-live; stamps are never color-only (collected slots carry a ✓ glyph); each interval bar has its numeric value; under prefers-reduced-motion the stamp animation and bar transitions drop and numbers update instantly.

goal.zh: 做一张可玩的咖啡集章卡:总章数与起点预盖章数可调;点击「打卡集章」逐格盖章,演示实时记录每次打卡的间隔(距上一章的毫秒数)并画成逐章柱状序列——让用户亲眼看到自己越接近目标点得越快;到达终点给达标庆祝与「再来一轮」。
goal.en: Build a playable coffee punch card: adjustable total stamps and pre-punched head start; each 'punch' click fills a slot while the demo records the real interval since the previous stamp, drawn as a per-stamp bar sequence — letting users watch themselves accelerate toward the goal; reaching the end triggers a finish celebration and 'another round'.

acceptance.zh: steps/headStart 为 JS 型参数经 store 订阅;改动即重开一轮,headStart 预盖格必须带「预盖」视觉标记且如实标注人为进度
acceptance.en: steps/headStart are JS-type params consumed via store subscription; changing them restarts the round, and head-start slots carry a visible 'pre-stamped' mark honestly labeled as artificial progress

acceptance.zh: 间隔=距上一章的真实毫秒数(第 1 章相对本轮起点),逐章柱状呈现 + 最近/最短/最长文本,不只靠读图
acceptance.en: Interval = real milliseconds since the previous stamp (stamp 1 measured from round start), shown per-stamp as bars plus latest/min/max text — never chart-only

acceptance.zh: 「已集 n/N · 百分比 · 还差 m 章」三组文本实时同步并 aria-live 播报;已集格带 ✓ 字符,不靠颜色单独区分
acceptance.en: 'n/N · percent · m left' text stays in sync and is announced via aria-live; collected slots carry a ✓ glyph, never color-only

acceptance.zh: 达标后按钮转为「再来一轮」,庆祝态为一次性动画;prefers-reduced-motion 下全部动画取消、数值即时更新
acceptance.en: On completion the button becomes 'another round'; the celebration is a one-shot animation; under prefers-reduced-motion all animation drops and numbers update instantly

acceptance.zh: 标注 Hull 1932/1934 与 Kivetz/Urminsky/Zheng 出处;steps/headStart 标注为 demo 教学参数,定律本身不规定数值
acceptance.en: Cite Hull 1932/1934 and Kivetz/Urminsky/Zheng; label steps/headStart as demo teaching params — the law itself sets no numbers
